# onepassword_vault (Resource)

Manages a 1Password vault using service account or desktop app authentication. Vault management is not available with 1Password Connect. Service accounts can only access vaults assigned to them or created by them, cannot manage vaults created using another authentication method, cannot update vault metadata, and can only delete or manage group permissions for vaults they created.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "onepassword_vault" "example" {
  name                = "Terraform managed vault"
  description         = "Managed by Terraform"
  allow_admins_access = true

  group_permissions {
    group_id = "2hinhvewsxob5p3he2cr2ylihy"
    permissions = [
      "read_items",
      "reveal_item_password",
      "create_items",
      "update_items",
    ]
  }

  group_permissions {
    group_id = "3gjoowf6ofrcjldq5z7v6h3cde"
    permissions = [
      "read_items",
    ]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the vault.

### Optional

- `allow_admins_access` (Boolean) Whether members of the Administrators group can access the vault. Defaults to `true`. This is only configurable when the vault is created, so changing it replaces the vault.
- `description` (String) The description of the vault.
- `group_permissions` (Block Set) Group access managed by this resource. Repeat this block to manage multiple groups. Groups omitted from this block are not managed, and importing a vault does not automatically adopt its existing group access. The 1Password SDK currently identifies groups by UUID and does not expose lookup by name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--group_permissions))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The Terraform resource identifier in the format `vaults/<vault_id>`.
- `uuid` (String) The UUID of the vault.

<a id="nestedblock--group_permissions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `group_permissions`

Required:

- `group_id` (String) The UUID of the group.
- `permissions` (Set of String) The complete permission set for the group. Supported values: `archive_items`, `create_items`, `delete_items`, `export_items`, `import_items`, `manage_vault`, `no_access`, `print_items`, `read_items`, `reveal_item_password`, `send_items`, `update_item_history`, `update_items`. Permission dependencies vary by account type and are validated by 1Password.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Vaults can be imported using their Terraform identifier.
terraform import onepassword_vault.example vaults/2hinhvewsxob5p3he2cr2ylihy
```
